15+
Years in business

Built on the chair, not the coupon

State Street Barbers calls itself a luxury grooming experience — and after 15+ years, that claim rests on the work itself: hot-towel classic shaves, straight-razor beard work and precision cuts, done the same careful way every visit.

  • Hot-towel classic shaves
  • Straight-razor beard work
  • Precision cuts, not rushed cuts
  • One flagship to book through — River North

This concept page proposes a cleaner way forward: one strong flagship homepage, a booking funnel for this location, clear prices — and a membership and retention offer, so regulars come back for the cut, not for the next discount deal.

Good to Know

Before you book

Where is the flagship?

600 N Kingsbury Street, Chicago, IL 60654 — River North. This page covers the River North flagship only.

When are you open?

Monday–Friday 8am–8pm; Saturday–Sunday 8am–4pm (River North location listing on the shop's own site).

How much is a haircut?

$45–55 on the shop's own pricelist; precision haircuts $60–70. The full price list is above.

Do you do hot-towel shaves?

Yes — classic hot-towel shaves ($55–65) and straight-razor beard work are core services here.
